description.zh: 非官方豆姐（Doujie）提供商插件：支持国内版、国际版（Dola）显式扫码入口与本地桌面会话导入。地区不会自动切换。与相关商业商标无关。
description.en: Unofficial Doujie provider: explicit domestic and international (Dola) QR entries plus desktop session import. Regions never switch automatically. Not affiliated with any commercial trademarks.
